admission.justification: Returning or titling an old or misplaced workspace could attach a new task actor to the wrong context or mutate archived history; refusal and preservation cases guard the boundary.

applicability: Every descriptor encountered in explicit task workspace preparation.
conditions: ID, project ID and resolved task directory are validated before successor continuation or workspace-title mutation.
Only a refreshed nonarchiving, nonarchived workspace is returned and titled.
exclusions: Rollback of the master project add/rename that precedes workspace validation.

evidence: evidence/A02/focused.log; ReopenedWorkspaceTests.test_successor_placement_mismatch_stops_without_renaming_or_further_creation and test_archived_replay_opens_a_successor_without_touching_the_archive; retained evidence/sandbox-A001/host-workspaces-after.json verifies the original archive timestamp and distinct live successor.

statement: Placement is checked before successor traversal or title mutation, and only the final live workspace receives the task title; archived workspaces and their actors are not reused or mutated.
